thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager — Canary failure observed for model-service/canary (v5.2.1). Error pattern: tokenization corruption + high perplexity spike. AlertID=INC-332999.

deploy-bot: Rollout ID `roll-2026-03-15-7f9a` started at 3329989900, target=canary; 10% traffic. Artifact: weights@sha256:abc123...; tokenizer bundle id tk-2026-03-15-9.

alex: i'm oncall — looking. linking logs and sample outputs.

jordan: seeing lots of invalid tokens in output stream (unicode � replacement, broken subword joins). Rate of bad responses ~3.8% of canary, latency normal. Customers complaining about gibberish.

maria: quick check — manifest shows tokenizer version tk-2026-03-15-9 but weights metadata references tokenizer tk-2026-02-28-2. possible packaging mismatch during promotion.

sofia: can we flip the feature flag to stop routing to v5.2.1? flag name is `model-routing.v5_2_1_enable` (default true).

alex: paging product-ops + cs for customer impact assessment. product-ops, customer-success pls chime in.

product-ops: reported increased ticket volume from 4 paying customers in EU region. minor customer-facing degradation (nonsensical summaries). no PII exposure.

customer-success: affected customers: 3 trial orgs + 1 paid; we escalated to account teams. asking for ETA.

jordan: i can confirm we have checksum mismatch warnings during artifact fetch on canary hosts: `WARN: tokenizer bundle checksum mismatch (expected tk-2026-02-28-2, got tk-2026-03-15-9)` — likely release pipeline linked wrong tokenizer artifact.

deploy-bot: Recent pipeline step: `promote-canary -> promote-weights` succeeded. `promote-tokenizer` step shows success but artifacts target different namespace. Investigating.

alex: mitigation plan: 1) flip kill-switch flag to route all traffic off v5.2.1 -> stable (v5.1.x) 2) pause further rollouts 3) create hotfix/promote correct tokenizer if needed. Who can flip the flag now?

sofia: i will flip the flag. running: `curl -X POST https://flags.redwood/api/flags/model-routing.v5_2_1_enable -d '{"value":false}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KGMT'`

sofia: done. flag change propagated to edge in ~12s. sending verification.

jordan: routing check: all canary traffic count dropped to 0. Canary pods still up but receiving 0 qps. Stable back to 100%.

incident-bot: Automated check: error-rate on production model-service dropped from 2.9% -> 0.2% within 40s of flag flip. Canary responses still stored for forensic sampling.

maria: collecting failing samples and uploading to S3 under s3://incidents/3329990001/samples/; note: do not include PII.

alex: good. setting incident status = mitigation in progress. forwarding to infra-release for root cause. jordan/maria, can you triage the pipeline and artifact registry?

jordan: starting artifact audit. early finding: artifact promotion script used `latest-tokenizer` tag which pointed to tk-2026-03-15-9 in canary namespace due to a race; weights promotion referenced previous stable tokenizer id. So mismatch introduced during rolling publish.

maria: we have also observed config drift in model-config.yaml for canary: `tokenizer: latest` vs stable pinned `tokenizer: tk-2026-02-28-2`. Release guidelines require pinned ids.

alex: action items (captured):
- A1 (sofia): keep kill-switch off (confirmed) and hold promotion queue.
- A2 (jordan + maria): reproduce packaging race locally, produce script fix for promotion pipeline to pin tokenizer id.
- A3 (deploy-bot): add CI gate to verify tokenizer/weights manifest checksum equality before promote.
- A4 (product-ops + customer-success): send postmortem note to affected customers and offer rollback summary.
- A5 (audit-bot): record flag flip and roll actions for compliance.

sofia: i've created temporary incident channel #inc-332999 and added deployment leads.

deploy-bot: created ticket DL-332999 (CI gate) and PR drafted: https://git.internal/redwood/releases/pull/4827

jordan: reproducer steps for devs (pasted):
```
# simulate promotion race
upload_tokenizer tk-2026-03-15-9 --namespace canary
promote_weights --tag roll-2026-03-15-7f9a --tokenizer latest
# previous publish step may still reference old stable tokenizer id
```

maria: forensics: sample outputs show broken subword merges and spurious separators, e.g. `I am go@@` -> `I am go��`. attaching a couple of sanitized examples to the ticket.

product-ops: CS draft sent to accounts. refunds not requested yet; monitoring for impact window (3329989800 -> 3329990000).

alex: since mitigation is in place and customers are notified, we'll follow up with a full postmortem. handing off to oncall-secondary jordan for deep dive — alex going OOO in 30m. jordan, you're lead.

jordan: acknowledged. i'll take lead for RCA and coordinate patch. tagging maria and sofia.

sofia: audit-bot, record: `flag_change(model-routing.v5_2_1_enable=false) by sofia at 3329990063`

audit-bot: recorded. UID=AU-332999-0063.

incident-bot: Incident state -> mitigated (canary traffic stopped). Next steps: RCA doc, pipeline hotfix, CI gate, and postmortem to be published in 72h.

alex: thanks team. closing pager alert for oncall rotation; jordan will update thread with RCA summary.

jordan: working notes: expected timeline for hotfix PR + rollout freeze removal ~ 6-8 hours pending code review and smoke tests. will update with a timeline and linked PRs.

maria: saving logs and manifest snapshots to /var/log/incidents/332999 and s3 for retention.

product-ops: follow-up: coordinate postmortem sync at 1500 PT today.

alex: closing handoff. good job.

sofia: small note — we should add a gating check to the promotion script: fail if `manifest.tokenizer_id != weights.tokenizer_ref`. I'll add to PR.

jordan: noted. I'll include unit tests for the gating logic.

incident-bot: Thread archived for initial mitigation; tag=mitigated, priority=high, owner=jordan.
